text: No trees were cut down on this property after 2020. The analysis found no tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger between 2021 and 2025. While small changes (under 0.5 ha) or those at the edges may have gone undetected due to the 30-meter pixel resolution, no significant deforestation occurred within the full boundary of the 130.9-hectare rural property during this period.
